name: Siraj ud-Daulah
contribution: As Nawab of Bengal, he led resistance against East India Company encroachment and commanded Bengal's side in the Battle of Plassey in 1757.
context: Bengal Subah, 1756-1757; confrontation with the East India Company over sovereignty and control.
impact: His defeat at Plassey became a foundational turning point in the political subordination of Bengal.
